The '''Ho'Din-style veggie omelet''' was served as a breakfast dish at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]]<ref name="DD" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> The veggie [[Omelette/Legends|omelet]] was done in the style of the [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]]<ref name="DD" /> [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="GG4">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref> and was the number five [[Pantoran Plate Specials|Pantoran Plate Special]] at the diner on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], selling at 5.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] each.<ref name="DD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ho'Din-style veggie omelet was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," a [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive article written by [[Gregory Walker]] in the form of an [[in-universe]] menu.<ref name="DD" />
